title: Offline Tag Assignment Session Removal Delivery
summary: remove browser assignment staging, session UI, export/import reconciliation, server endpoints, configuration, and tests while preserving direct saves
content_html:
Offline Tag Assignment Session Removal Delivery

Complete Result

Series Tag Editor saves assignments only through the direct Local Studio API. Series Tags shows canonical coverage without offline overlays, Session or Import controls, or reconciliation state.

No executable browser or server path reads, writes, exports, imports, previews, applies, or clears the tag_assignments_offline_v1 session.

Data Disposition Gate

Before implementation, inspect the intended Studio browser profile for dotlineform.studio.tagAssignmentsOffline.v1.

If it contains needed work, export or reconcile that work before removal. The delivery does not migrate browser-local data into canonical assignments and does not retain runtime cleanup or compatibility code merely to erase an inert key. Any stale key left in a browser profile is outside the shipped application contract after removal.

In Scope

  • Remove offline-session storage, normalization, clone/update helpers, copy, download, clear, and imported-entry cleanup.
  • Remove Series Tag Editor save-mode switching, staged-row gating, offline base snapshots, offline status copy, and dynamic offline workflow loading.
  • Keep failed direct-save edits in the current editor state with a clear service-unavailable or save-failed result.
  • Remove Series Tags Session and Import controls, modal hosts, lazy modules, session/import route modes, staged overlays, conflict controls, and related text/styles.
  • Remove assignment-session import preview/apply routes, dispatch, capabilities, runtime service keys, handlers, validation/planning, and activity actions.
  • Remove offline/import-only tests and refocus remaining tests on direct save, canonical coverage, route boot, and unavailable-service behavior.
  • Update durable documentation and current route/service inventories.

Not In Scope

  • Changing canonical assignment schema, values, inheritance, normalization, or atomic write ownership.
  • Changing Series Tags coverage scoring, filters, sorting, or editor links.
  • Changing tag registry, aliases, groups, promotion/demotion, or catalogue membership.
  • Registry and alias bulk-import retirement, which remains owned by Tag Vocabulary Import Retirement.
  • A replacement offline queue, automatic retry, sync service, patch workflow, or browser-storage cleanup shim.

  • studio/app/frontend/js/series-tags.js
  • studio/app/frontend/js/series-tags-render.js
  • studio/app/frontend/js/series-tags-modals.js
  • studio/app/frontend/js/series-tags-import-workflow.js
  • studio/app/frontend/js/tag-ui.js
  • studio/app/frontend/js/tag-ui-text.js
  • studio/app/frontend/routes/series-tags.html
  • studio/services/tags/tag_source_model.py
  • studio/services/tags/tag_assignment_service.py
  • studio/services/tags/tag_routes.py
  • studio/services/tags/tag_activity.py
  • studio/app/server/studio/studio_tag_api/assignments.py
  • studio/app/server/studio/studio_tags_api.py
  • studio/app/server/studio/studio_app_config.py
  • studio/data/config/runtime/activity-contract.json
  • focused assignment service, route, runtime-config, editor, Series Tags, and route-shell tests

These are inspection starting points. Confirm live imports and consumers before deleting shared helpers.

Completion And Evidence

  • Valid direct series/work assignment saves retain current validation, normalization, atomic replacement, reload, and activity behavior.
  • Service-unavailable and failed-save paths do not write browser storage, clear current edits, or claim success.
  • Series Tags renders canonical coverage with no offline status overlay, Session control, Import control, modal host, or import workflow module.
  • The Studio tag API no longer registers, advertises, or dispatches assignment import preview/apply endpoints.
  • Scoped source searches find no executable tag_assignments_offline_v1, dotlineform.studio.tagAssignmentsOffline.v1, assignment-session import, or offline-save dependency; historical Roadmap text is not executable.
  • Registry and alias import behavior is unaffected by this delivery.
  • studio/data/canonical/tags/tag-assignments.json is byte-for-byte unchanged by removal implementation and verification.
  • Focused service/API tests, JavaScript module checks, route boot checks, a manual direct-save failure review, and git diff --check support only the bounded claims above.

Durable Destination

Update Series Tag Editor to describe direct save as its only persistence mode. Update Series Tags as the canonical-only coverage view, and Tag Services so assignment import is no longer a mutation family.
